title: The Mysterious Affair at Styles
author: Agatha Christie
notes: Hastings narrates; PDNC marks narrator speech with 'Narr' / '_narr', mapped to his key. PDNC's text replaced every non-ASCII character with one space per UTF-8 byte (an em dash became three spaces, an e-acute two) and wrote right single quotes as straight apostrophes: convert with --reference-text pointing at the Gutenberg edition; mode 'bytes' moves every span accordingly. reference_text.extra_lines restores a line whose wording differs between PDNC's edition and Gutenberg's (PDNC 'indeed', Gutenberg 'induced'), keeping PDNC's words.

extra_lines: believe—or her unconsciousness was indeed by artificial means.
